tunnel.title: Backup route via WireGuard
tunnel.lead: If this server cannot reach Telegram directly (for example in Russia), upload a WireGuard config: a .conf file or a .zip with one. Only requests to Telegram go through the tunnel; nothing else on the server changes.

modeHint.auto: Direct first. If Telegram does not answer, the bot switches to WireGuard and tries direct again every 10 minutes.
modeHint.always: All requests to Telegram go through WireGuard only.
modeHint.off: The config is kept but not used.

tunnel.noBinary: This build has no wireproxy, the tunnel cannot start. Update the container.
tunnel.keysHint: Keys from the file stay on this server and are never shown on the page again.
tunnel.bad_format: This does not look like a WireGuard config: it needs [Interface] with PrivateKey and Address and [Peer] with PublicKey and Endpoint.
tunnel.no_conf: There is no .conf file in the archive.
tunnel.many_conf: The archive has several .conf files. Keep one, or upload the right .conf on its own.
tunnel.too_big: The file is too big for a WireGuard config.
tunnel.amnezia: This is an AmneziaWG config (it has Jc, Jmin, H1…). Plain WireGuard is needed; the Amnezia app can export one.
